main_text.p: prium est, participarent etiam in divinitate. Lege igitur in textu, lin. 17. non [ essentiam suam scire ] sed [per essentiam suam scire] Sic enim & quid per scire لااتا intelligant docet nos Alsharestanins, ubi inter عالم لااتا لا بعلم Scientem per essentiam suam non per scientiam, & ذاته عالم بعلم هو ذاته per scientiam quæ ipsius essentia sit (quæ Abi Hodhaili Ahmedis forma loquendi fuit) distinguit, quod scil. verba priora sint نفي الصفة Negatio attributi, seu proprietatis, (ut & loquitur Author noster) posteriora vero اثبات ذات هو بعينها صفة affirmatio essentiæ quæ ipsa sit attributum, vel اثبات صفة هي بعينها ذات affirmatio attributi, quod ipsum sit essentia. Sed nec omnes qui formam istā لااتا per essentiam suam usurpabant, eodem modo illam intelligebant, eodem teste, qui Al Jobbaiensis sententiam sic explicat, quòd cùm diceret Deum scire لاينقضي كونه عالما, hoc vellet, لا يقتضي كونه عالما هي علم اوحال يوجب كونه عالما non ponere illud quòd sciens sit, attributum quod sit scientia, aut statum qui necessarium faciat ut sit sciens. At ex Abi Al-Hashemi ipsius filii, sententia, illud de Deo dictum, innuere اذ وحالة هي صفة معلومة ورا كونه ذاتا esse ipsi dispositionem [seu conditionem ] quæ sit proprietas nota, posterior eo quod sit essentia existens, atque ita in reliquis attributis: Porrò monet idem, quæstionem istam de attributis Dei, sub initio fuisse غير نضيجة nondum maturam, deinde verò à Wasels sectatoribus post lectos Philosophorum libros, ad maturitatem perductam.

page.notes: Arabic and Greek-style passages are reproduced as far as legible; the Arabic script is rendered loosely and several Arabic words are doubtful, so they should be checked against the scan. The Arabic lines within the Latin text are marked by their context only. Some Latin words in the first lines are faint. The catchword "Fogientes" is faint at the foot. Possible print-level doubts: "Alsharestanins" (al-Shahrastani), "Abi Hodhaili Ahmedis", "Al Jobbaiensis", "Abi Al-Hashemi", "Wasels" (Wāṣil) are copied as printed.
